hook.kn: ದಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬರುವುದು ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅವಕಾಶದ ಉಪಗಣ {2, 4, 6}. ಪ್ರತಿ ಘಟನೆಯೂ S ನ ಒಂದು ಉಪಗಣ.

objectives.en: Describe events as subsets of S
Classify events as impossible, sure, simple, compound or complementary

narration.en: Getting an even number on a die is the subset {2, 4, 6} of the sample space. Every event is a subset of S.
narration.kn: ದಾಳದಲ್ಲಿ ಸಮಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಬರುವುದು ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅವಕಾಶದ ಉಪಗಣ {2, 4, 6}. ಪ್ರತಿ ಘಟನೆಯೂ S ನ ಒಂದು ಉಪಗಣ.

body.en: An event is any subset E of the sample space S. We say E occurs if the outcome of the experiment belongs to E. A sample space with $n$ outcomes has $2^n$ events.
body.kn: ಘಟನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅವಕಾಶದ ಒಂದು ಉಪಗಣ. ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಆ ಉಪಗಣದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಘಟನೆ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತೇವೆ.

narration.en: An event is just a subset of the sample space. It happens when the outcome lands inside that subset.
narration.kn: ಘಟನೆ ಎಂದರೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅವಕಾಶದ ಒಂದು ಉಪಗಣ. ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ ಆ ಉಪಗಣದಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ ಘಟನೆ ಸಂಭವಿಸಿದೆ ಎನ್ನುತ್ತೇವೆ.

narration.en: Throw a die. The sample space S has six outcomes, 1 to 6. Draw S as a rectangle with the outcomes inside.

say.en: Throw a die. The sample space S has six outcomes, 1 to 6. Draw S as a rectangle with the outcomes inside.
An event is any subset of S. "An even number shows" is the event A equal to 2, 4, 6: draw a ring round those outcomes.
An event with one outcome is simple; with more than one, compound. S itself is the sure event and the empty set the impossible event.
Everything outside A is the complement, A dash: an odd number shows. A six-outcome sample space has 2 to the 6, that is 64, events.

body.en: Impossible event: $\varnothing$. Sure event: S itself. Simple (elementary) event: exactly one outcome. Compound event: more than one outcome. The complement of A is $A' = S - A$, the event "not A".
body.kn: ಖಾಲಿ ಗಣ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ ಘಟನೆ, S ಖಚಿತ ಘಟನೆ. ಒಂದೇ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವಿದ್ದರೆ ಸರಳ ಘಟನೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದ್ದರೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಘಟನೆ. A′ ಎಂದರೆ "A ಅಲ್ಲ".

narration.en: The empty set is the impossible event and S is the sure event. One outcome makes a simple event, more than one a compound event, and A dash is "not A".
narration.kn: ಖಾಲಿ ಗಣ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ ಘಟನೆ, S ಖಚಿತ ಘಟನೆ. ಒಂದೇ ಫಲಿತಾಂಶವಿದ್ದರೆ ಸರಳ ಘಟನೆ, ಹೆಚ್ಚು ಇದ್ದರೆ ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ ಘಟನೆ. A′ ಎಂದರೆ "A ಅಲ್ಲ".

caption.en: A sample space with k outcomes has 2ᵏ subsets, so 2ᵏ events. Change k and count the simple and compound events.

narration.en: A sample space with k outcomes has 2ᵏ subsets, so 2ᵏ events. Change k and count the simple and compound events. k = 2 (one coin): 4 events — ∅, {H}, {T}, S.

tryThis.en: k = 6 (one die): 64 events, of which 57 are compound.
Why do we subtract 1 for the compound count?

problem.en: A die is rolled. Write E: "a number greater than 4", F: "a prime number", and the complement of F.

Roll-call quiz. When your roll number is called, give your answer.
narration.kn: ಹಾಜರಿ ರಸಪ್ರಶ್ನೆ. ನಿಮ್ಮ ಹಾಜರಿ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ ಕರೆದಾಗ ನಿಮ್ಮ ಉತ್ತರ ಹೇಳಿ.

points.en: An event is a subset of the sample space.
Simple: one outcome; compound: more than one.
points.kn: ಸರಳ: ಒಂದು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ; ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು.

homework.en: Three coins are tossed. Write the events "exactly two heads", "at least two heads" and "at most two heads".

narration.en: Recap. An event is a subset of the sample space. ∅ is impossible; S is sure. Simple: one outcome; compound: more than one. A′ = S − A is "not A".
narration.kn: ಪುನರಾವರ್ತನೆ. ಘಟನೆ ಮಾದರಿ ಅವಕಾಶದ ಉಪಗಣ. ∅ ಅಸಾಧ್ಯ ಘಟನೆ; S ಖಚಿತ ಘಟನೆ. ಸರಳ: ಒಂದು ಫಲಿತಾಂಶ; ಸಂಯುಕ್ತ: ಒಂದಕ್ಕಿಂತ ಹೆಚ್ಚು. A′ = S − A ಎಂದರೆ "A ಅಲ್ಲ".
